newsitem.title: USA: America's Health buys A.H. Belo stake.
newsitem.headline: America's Health buys A.H. Belo stake.

text.p: America's Health Network, a cable television network focusing on health and medicine, said Tuesday that it had purchased A.H. Belo Corp's majority interest in the company for undisclosed terms.

The company said the sale of Belo's interest leaves Access Health Inc, Allen & Co Inc, IVI Publishing Inc, Medical Innovation Partners and America's Health Network's two senior executives Webster Golinkin and Joe Maddox, as the company's largest shareholders.

The company said that on May 14, Belo, Columbia/HCA Healthcare Corp, and America's Health Network announced an agreement in principle whereby Columbia would purchase Belo's majority interest. It added, however, that following senior management changes and the broadening federal investigation of Columbia/HCA, that company said on July 30 that it was not pursuing the transaction.
